a Bachelor’s degree in related area plus three (3) years of related experience/training. Experience managing complex territories and strategic accounts.
Experience collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams; and navigate healthcare organizations to identify and advance business opportunities.

Builds relationships with new providers. Provides services to strengthen physician relationships and meet physician needs.
